description: Everything One Coworking publishes about one venue, as Markdown: address, district, starting prices with units and the date they were checked, private offices the operator confirmed (price, desks, m², term, move-in date, confirmation date), opening hours, amenities, rating, FAQ, and how to book or request an offer. `slug` is the last path segment of the venue URL (https://www.onecoworking.com/venues/{slug}).
name: get_venue
title: Get a venue
